task:
Design kit, phase 1: shared visual tokens and element styles for the whole app — Elite Dangerous orange on glossy gunmetal/midnight navy with a neon deep-blue secondary, rounded glossy panels, pill buttons, tabs, chips and pop-outs. apps/web only; no markup/layout restructuring in this phase, no behaviour change.

WHY: the owner has approved a visual direction (a concept pack: glossy dark-navy panels with a soft top highlight, Elite orange primary actions, neon blue secondary accents, pill buttons, tabbed sections, closable pop-outs, HUD-style condensed uppercase headings). Today `apps/web/src/app.css` has only a handful of tokens (`--color-void`, `--color-panel`, `--color-signal #ff7a14`, `--color-cyan`, `--line`, `--muted`, `--panel-raised`, `--metal`) and most components style themselves locally with hard-coded colours, so the look cannot be changed in one place.

TOKENS (define in `app.css` `:root`, keep the existing names working as aliases so nothing breaks):
- Surfaces: `--bg-void: #080d17` (page), `--bg-deep: #0b1220`, `--panel: #121c2e` (default panel), `--panel-raised: #172539`, `--panel-sunken: #0d1524`, `--panel-gloss: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.10), rgba(255,255,255,0) 38%)` (top highlight overlay), `--line: #26405f`, `--line-strong: #3a5a84`, `--line-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(61,165,255,.18), 0 0 24px rgba(61,165,255,.10)`.
- Text: `--text: #e8eef7`, `--text-muted: #9fb0c7`, `--text-dim: #6f84a0`.
- Primary (Elite orange): `--accent: #ff7a14`, `--accent-hi: #ff9a3c`, `--accent-text: #1a0d02` (text on orange), `--accent-glow: 0 0 22px rgba(255,122,20,.35)`.
- Secondary (neon deep blue): `--neon: #3da5ff`, `--neon-hi: #5ec8ff`, `--neon-soft: rgba(61,165,255,.16)`.
- States: `--ok: #4ade80`, `--warn: #e9c46a`, `--danger: #f87171`, `--focus: var(--accent)`.
- Shape: `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius: 14px`, `--radius-lg: 20px`, `--radius-pill: 999px`; `--shadow-panel: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06)`.
- Type: keep Inter for body; add `--font-hud: 'Saira Semi Condensed', 'Inter', sans-serif` (self-host or load from Google Fonts through the existing font loading approach; if the repo policy forbids a remote font, bundle it under `apps/web/static/fonts` with its OFL licence file) for h1/h2 page titles and section eyebrows, uppercase with `letter-spacing: .06em`. Tier colours (`--color-tier-*`) unchanged.
- Motion: `--ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, 160–220 ms transitions on hover/focus only; honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.

ELEMENT STYLES (global, in `app.css`, scoped to the app's own classes/roles, not Tailwind resets):
- Panels: every `section`/`article`/`.panel`-like surface that currently uses `--panel-raised` or `--metal` gets `background: var(--panel)` + the gloss overlay via `::before` (or `background-image` layering), `border: 1px solid var(--line)`, `border-radius: var(--radius-lg)`, `box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel)`.
- Buttons: default `button` → pill, `background: var(--panel-raised)`, 1px `--line` border, hover raises to `--line-strong` + subtle glow; `.primary`/`.apply`/primary actions (Inspect, Apply, Find systems, Add to plan) → orange gradient (`--accent` → `--accent-hi`), `--accent-text`, `--accent-glow` on hover; `.secondary-button`/`.quiet-button` → outlined neon (`--neon` border, transparent fill). Disabled: 55% opacity, no glow. Keep all existing class names.
- Tabs (`[role="tablist"]`/`[role="tab"]`): underline style, active tab text `--text` with a 2px `--accent` underline and `aria-selected` styling; inactive `--text-muted`.
- Chips (filter chips, `.filter-chip`, `.paused-label`): outlined `--neon`, pill, `--neon-soft` fill, × button inherits.
- Inputs/selects/range: dark sunken field (`--panel-sunken`), `--line` border, focus ring `--focus`; range thumb orange, track neon-soft.
- Pop-outs (`[role="dialog"][aria-modal="false"]`): panel style + stronger shadow + a 4-dot grab affordance in the header (decorative), header with title and Close; `--radius-lg`.
- Switches (`[role="switch"]`): track `--panel-sunken`/`--line`, knob, checked track `--accent`.
- Status/notice text: `--text-muted`; errors `--danger`; `role="status"` lines unchanged in structure.

ADOPTION in this phase (token replacement only, no layout changes): `WorkspaceHeader.svelte`, the home page (`routes/+page.svelte`), `ExploreWorkspace.svelte`, `BodyFilters.svelte`, `ArchetypePicker.svelte`, `FinderResultRanking.svelte`, the Inspect `SystemDetail.svelte`, Plan panes (`features/plan/*.svelte`) and `SpatialCanvas.svelte`'s toolbar: replace hard-coded hex/hsl colours and radii in their `<style>` blocks with the tokens above (search for `#` colours and `hsl(` in those files). Do not rename classes, test ids, roles or text; do not move elements.

TESTS: a vitest contract test that `app.css` defines every token above and that the listed component files contain no hard-coded hex/hsl colour outside an allowlist (tier colours, `transparent`, `currentColor`, `white`/`#fff` for the skip link); existing component tests must keep passing (they assert roles/text, not colours). Run the Cypress product/plan specs if the local lane exists; otherwise CI.

VALIDATION: in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; say this is a global visual change that needs visual validation (Product E2E screenshots) before production promotion and is not deployed.
